logp.method_description: The lipid-water partition coefficients of [99mTc]4.1-4.4 were performed under the circumstance of n-octanol and PBS (0.025 mol/L, pH = 7.4). 0.1 mL solution of [99mTc]4.1-4.4 was pipetted into a 15.0 mL test tube containing 3.0 mL n-octanol and 2.9 mL PBS. The mixture was vortexed for 3 min then centrifuged for 5 min (3000 rpm). A fixed volume of liquid was pipetted respectively from the n-octanol (500 µL) and PBS (100 µL) phase, transferred and added into two test tubes, then the radioactivity were counted. One milliliter of n-octanol was pipetted into a new 15.0 mL test tube containing 2.0 mL n-octanol and 3.0 mL PBS. The vortexing, centrifuging, and counting were repeated according to the methods mentioned above until consistent partition coefficient values were obtained. The calculated value of the lipid-water partition coefficient abided by the equation: Log D = Log (count n-octanol / count PBS).
